item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Anna of the North - Crazy Life (Spatial Audio) (2022) [ALAC]
item.description:
Sadly there wasn't a good tidal ripper for 360 audio back when I tried to get this (or I was probably too dumb). Now that Tidal yeeted Sony 360, only the Apple Spatial Audio version exists, and because I don't have a Mac, I can't rip it myself .

Every other artist that I would want the spatial audio files for put it on Amazon which I can rip easily, but this one album doesn't have the spatial audio files on Amazon Music frustratingly.
item.author: TSMKFail
